latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Subtitle — Generate and embed subtitles in your videos through a fast, cloud-based workflow.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for subtitle generation.
- Supports automatic subtitle creation in multiple languages (e.g. English, Japanese).
- Cloud-based processing: no manual installation or setup required.
- Download finished 1080p MP4 videos with embedded subtitles in 30–90 seconds.
- Includes session management, error handling, and export via secure API token system.
- User-friendly prompts and detailed workflow guidance for content creators and educators.
